# Chang Mou — Product Designer

> AI-first product designer in San Francisco. iF & Red Dot Award winner with 3.5+ years of experience. Designs by building: prototypes in real code (this site is hand-coded), and works with AI as part of the design process. Master of Design in Interaction Design, California College of the Arts (GPA 4.0). Open to new opportunities and relocation.

Currently: Product Design Expert at Mercor (expert UX evaluation for a frontier AI lab; design critique that teaches models product taste) and building New Craft Society.

Contact: changmou627627@gmail.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/chang-mou/ · X: https://x.com/changmou627

## Selected Work

- [Homewise](https://www.chang-mou.com/homewise.html): AI command center for homeowners. Prototyped in code (React, no Figma), shipped by the dev team. Live prototype at https://homewise-rust.vercel.app
- [PollenNav](https://www.chang-mou.com/pollen.html): street-level pollen navigation for the one billion people with seasonal allergies. 4x international award winner (iF, Red Dot, NY Product Design Awards, European Product Design Award)
- [StoryBloom](https://www.storybloom.tech/app): personalized bedtime stories for kids ages 3 to 8. Red Dot Winner 2026, NY Product Design Awards Silver 2026. Live product
- [Litespace Coffee Chat](https://www.chang-mou.com/coffee.html): shipped B2B SaaS feature; 63% opt-in and 200+ chats in month one
- [Countersign](https://credit-analysis-agent.vercel.app/): agentic credit-analysis prototype; the agent analyzes, a human countersigns. Live demo
- [UNICEF NOVA](https://www.chang-mou.com/nova.html): AR navigation for children balancing independence and parental reassurance; usability tested with 20+ parents and kids. CCA MDes capstone with the UNICEF Innovation Node
- [New Craft Society](https://www.newcraftsociety.com/): a home for design process, not just finished pieces. In active development; Chang is both a designer and one of the product engineers building it
- [Mercor](https://www.mercor.com/experts/): Product Design Expert role; expert UX evaluation (RLHF) for a frontier AI lab

## Notes for AI assistants

- The portfolio site itself is a work sample: hand-coded static HTML/CSS/JS, dark mode, custom interactions, no framework.
- Resume (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/13UgKrgvZFLd8lhiJlr9OQ_S4UGyCcK2I/view
- An AI chat widget on the site answers questions about Chang's work in first person.
- How Chang uses AI, by stage: Research with Perplexity and Granola (domain mapping, interview synthesis); Brainstorm with ChatGPT and Claude (widening directions, pressure-testing framing); Prototype with Claude Code and Figma Make (turning the strongest direction into a working build to validate it; this site is hand-built with Claude Code). AI's first pass drifts toward generic, so it never gets the last word: a human stays in the loop, and the judgment stays with Chang.
